verdict.rationale: Insomnia ships an official Inso CLI that can run collections, execute tests, and lint OpenAPI specs in CI (insomnia-docs-3, -39, -49, -53), giving some automation parity with the UI, but the docs never claim a full API/CLI surface that mirrors all UI capabilities (e.g., creating/editing requests, managing environments, mock servers, or GraphQL/gRPC configuration) programmatically. Missing for 10: evidence of CLI/API coverage for request creation/editing, environment management, mock server configuration, and other core UI features beyond test running and spec linting.
